target.statement: Stacking ensemble (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM, SVC base models + logistic regression meta-learner) achieves 97.2% accuracy on the stroke prediction test set
target.dataset: Full-Filled Brain Stroke Dataset (Kaggle, 4,981 records, 11 features)

compute.basis: Small tabular dataset (~4.3k rows after outlier removal) with sklearn/XGBoost/LightGBM on CPU; the whole pipeline (preprocess, SMOTE, 5-fold CV, stacking) runs in minutes, but the exact stacking recipe (base-model set per feature set, meta-learner inputs) is only partially specified, so some re-derivation is needed.

blockers: No code released; stacking ensemble composition and per-feature-set base-model choices are described inconsistently (text mentions DT/LightGBM/KNN/RF/MLP for one set, RF/XGBoost/LightGBM/SVC for the headline), so exact 97.2% may not be reproducible
Paper text is internally inconsistent (e.g., 'emotion classification in Bangla sentences' appears in results section), suggesting copy-paste errors that complicate faithful reproduction
Kaggle dataset requires a free account/API token to download
title: Advancing Tabular Stroke Modelling Through a Novel Hybrid Architecture and Feature-Selection Synergy
